environment.hardware: MacBook Air Apple M5, 10 CPU cores, 32 GiB RAM

methodology: Release timing runs used optimized SwiftPM test bundles, fresh processes, sequential execution, warm/uncontrolled filesystem caches. Count and debug diagnostics runs were separate. RSS is process memory, not allocation count. Browser-clean replaces an exploratory run that overlapped fixture creation.

fixtures.navigation: synthetic flat global root, 100k and 1M files
fixtures.browser: existing default synthetic wide fixture, 1,001,001 nodes
